children: Control Empresarial De Capitales S.A. De C.V., a 10% owner, reported a direct sale of PBF Energy Class A common shares. The shares were sold at a weighted average price of $80.5998 per share, with individual sale prices ranging from $80.51 to $80.61. The total sale amount reported was $12,089,970. Following the transaction, the reporter directly owned 13,716,127 Class A common shares of PBF Energy.
